candidates.name: Production Baseline v0 (RunningMode.VIDEO)
candidates.initial_claim: Standard synchronous MediaPipe execution (detect_for_video).
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Synchronous inference blocks camera frame reading; causes camera frame drops and high pipeline latency.

candidates.name: LIVE_STREAM Polling (Async Callback + Main Loop Wait)
candidates.initial_claim: Non-blocking async callback stores result; main loop processes it on next iteration.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: 14.3 ms wait penalty between callback and gesture processing due to synchronization with main loop.

candidates.name: LIVE_STREAM_WORKER (Dedicated Event-Driven Control Worker)
candidates.initial_claim: Dedicated thread woken immediately by Event on callback arrival, eliminating callback-to-gesture latency.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Requires careful thread lifecycle management, deterministic shutdown, and shared lock.

candidates.name: Strict Monotonic Millisecond Enforcement
candidates.initial_claim: Enforces max(now_ms, last_timestamp_ms + 1) to satisfy MediaPipe requirement.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Negligible CPU overhead (< 1 microsecond per frame).

candidates.name: Bounded Metadata Storage & TTL Eviction
candidates.initial_claim: Prevents memory leaks from dropped frames by pruning records older than callback timestamp.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: None. O(1) dict operations.

candidates.name: In-place Frame Flip (cv2.flip dst=frame)
candidates.initial_claim: Flips image horizontally directly in camera buffer to eliminate memory allocation.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: None. Eliminates 2.76 MB GC thrash per frame.

candidates.name: Single-Pass Finger Angle & Geometric Caching
candidates.initial_claim: Precomputes palm center and reference distances once per hand; vectorizes joint angles.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Requires strict immutability of cached geometry structures.

candidates.name: OpenCV MSMF Constructor Parameters
candidates.initial_claim: Passing width/height/fps in VideoCapture constructor reduces sequential property setting delays.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Cleaner code, avoids redundant topology renegotiations, though MSMF open() still remains slow.

candidates.name: OpenCV MSMF Sequential .set() Calls
candidates.initial_claim: Configuring width, height, fps individually via cap.set() after open.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Each .set() triggers redundant Media Foundation Source Reader renegotiation (5.5s delay).

candidates.name: OpenCV MSMF Dynamic FOURCC Switch
candidates.initial_claim: Switching FOURCC dynamically to MJPG to reduce uncompressed transfer overhead.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: OpenCV MSMF C++ backend locks the color conversion node upon Source Reader creation.

candidates.name: CAP_PROP_BUFFERSIZE = 1
candidates.initial_claim: Setting CAP_PROP_BUFFERSIZE to 1 prevents driver frame buffering.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Fails silently on OpenCV MSMF; gives false sense of low latency.

candidates.name: Bounded Grab-Discard (max 2 grabs)
candidates.initial_claim: Drains queued stale frames in MSMF buffer if consumer stalls, without infinite loop risk.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Slight retrieve overhead (~4.4 ms), but prevents processing stale frames.

candidates.name: WinRT MediaFrameReader (Realtime Acquisition)
candidates.initial_claim: Modern UWP/WinRT frame reader with zero-copy acquisition and 100ns hardware timestamps.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: 13.4x faster startup and 20x lower jitter. Deferred from current prod due to winrt COM dependency packaging risk.

candidates.name: Threaded Single-Slot Camera Capture
candidates.initial_claim: Offloading cap.read() to dedicated background thread reduces main thread blocking.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Introduces 10% duplicate frames and 18 ms slot latency due to asynchronous polling drift.

candidates.name: Win32 SendInput vs PyAutoGUI (PAUSE=0)
candidates.initial_claim: Direct Win32 SendInput eliminates Python wrapper overhead.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Delta is 3.2 microseconds (sub-noise). Switching to ctypes SendInput adds maintainability risk for zero user-perceptible gain. Setting PAUSE=0 is the critical fix.

candidates.name: Windows Priority Class: ABOVE_NORMAL
candidates.initial_claim: Elevating process priority prevents background OS preemption during presentation.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Slight reduction in p95 tail jitter (~1 ms). Safe on Windows 11.

candidates.name: CPU Affinity: Dedicated P-Cores (Mask 0x00FF)
candidates.initial_claim: Pinning inference thread to Performance Cores eliminates core hopping and latency spikes.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Windows 11 Thread Director already places compute-intensive tasks on P-cores. Explicit pinning yields no improvement on Tiger Lake.

candidates.name: CPU Affinity: E-Cores Only (Mask 0x0F00)
candidates.initial_claim: Testing degradation if process is confined to lower-efficiency cores.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Demonstrates catastrophic pipeline failure if scheduled on low-power cores.

candidates.name: LiteRT CPU / GPU (TFLite Models)
candidates.initial_claim: Running raw hand_landmarker.tflite directly via LiteRT Windows GPU delegate.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: MediaPipe hand_landmarker is a multi-model task graph (palm detector + landmark regressor + crop transforms). Raw TFLite execution lacks pipeline orchestration.

candidates.name: ONNX Runtime DirectML / CUDA Pipeline
candidates.initial_claim: Re-implementing complete 9-stage pipeline in ONNX with DirectML/CUDA acceleration.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Multi-stage CPU-GPU synchronization negates gains on integrated Iris Xe GPU. Huge dependency bloat.

candidates.name: Adaptive Hand Count (num_hands=1 fallback)
candidates.initial_claim: Dynamically lowering num_hands to 1 when only one hand is detected to halve landmark computation.
candidates.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Violates fundamental requirement to track 2 simultaneous hands continuously.
